name: The Great Outdoors

angles.text: As a cook, you know a basic campfire helps a traveling party rest and recover in the wild.
As a hunter, you know campcraft is essential for trackers and rangers who live beneath open skies.

faq.answer: Raan, an experienced traveler, teaches wandering adventurers how to survive in the open wilderness.
faq.q: Who gives the quest The Great Outdoors?

aliases: what does the great outdoors teach
what do i learn from raan
faq.answer: The lesson teaches wilderness survival. Rest beside a basic campfire to gain Boosted Rest before dangerous journeys.
faq.q: What is the purpose of The Great Outdoors?

aliases: how to complete the great outdoors
faq.answer: Sit beside Raan's basic campfire and rest until you gain Boosted Rest.

aliases: where to go after the great outdoors
faq.answer: After the campfire lesson, Raan encourages you to visit nearby village trainers and learn a practical trade. Craftsmen can create camp fixtures suited to their craft.
faq.q: What does Raan suggest doing after completing the quest?

faq.answer: Boosted Rest is a restorative effect gained by resting beside an established campfire. It helps travelers recover while braving the elements.
Yes. Local trade trainers can teach you to craft useful camp fixtures suited to your craft, so you can maintain a specialized campsite outdoors.
faq.q: Do tradeskills allow adventurers to craft campsite fixtures?

sections.body: Raan has traveled the wilds and teaches others how to survive beyond settlement walls. Ambition and steel alone will not carry you through harsh weather; practical campcraft matters. He welcomes those seeking fortune and glory, and offers guidance to anyone willing to learn.
sections.title: Lessons in the Wild

sections.body:
Raan asks you to sit beside his basic campfire and rest until you gain Boosted Rest. Across Azeroth's wild places, knowing when to pause, make camp, and recover can mean the difference between life and death.

After the lesson, Raan directs you to nearby village trainers. There you can learn a trade and craft specialized fixtures for your campsite.
sections.title: The Warmth of the Hearth

summary: Raan welcomes new wanderers and shows them how to endure the wild. Rest by his basic campfire to gain Boosted Rest, then visit nearby trade trainers to learn practical professions.
